Name: Hearth and Home-Walls and Floors (AT)
Author: hypnagogie
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/R0Aclpbm.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
This pack includes all wallpaper and flooring for my Hearth & Home mod.  My aim was sort of retro cozy, and I did my best to make several complementary pairs/groups of patterns & colors to play with.

[b]Other packs in this collection
[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18487]Furniture[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18496]Kitchen[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20308]Kitchen AT pack for Asters Buildable Kitchen[/url]

[b]Installation
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download & install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246] ﻿Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ 
[*]Download this mod!
[*]Unzip and move both Alternative Textures and Hearth & Home - Walls & Floors to your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Find_your_game_folder]Stardew Valley Mods folder[/url]
[/list]
[b]Using Alternative Textures in game
[/b]
[list]
[*]You'll need to go to Robin's and buy a paint bucket (there are a few other tools, too, but not absolutely necessary).
[*]With the paint bucket equipped, click on the item you want to retexture (in this case, the wall or the floor).
[*]Use the keyword "hnh" to find the wall/floor options
[*]Play!
[/list]
